levels.title: Discovery Lab
levels.goal_text: Explore. Click a hotspot, see what happens.
levels.win_condition: unlock 'Start Task 1' button once at least 5 of the 8 available hotspots have been probed at least once. No fail state.
levels.intro_text: This is a working fly brain -- real wiring, not a diagram. Click anywhere lit up and watch what happens. There are no wrong answers here.

levels.title: Reach the Sugar
levels.win_condition: fly enters sugar_radius of sugar_position, then feed hotspot is clicked while fly remains inside sugar_radius.
levels.fail_condition: click_budget exhausted before win_condition is met.
levels.intro_text: Time to put what you found to use. No notebook this time -- just what you remember.

levels.title: Sugar + Shadow
levels.goal_text: Reach the sugar. Don't let the shadow catch you.
levels.win_condition: fly enters sugar_radius of sugar_position, then feed hotspot is clicked while fly remains inside sugar_radius, AND fly was not inside shadow's hit_area (unfrozen) during active_window_ms.
levels.fail_condition: fly is inside shadow's hit_area and NOT in a freeze_stop state at any point during active_window_ms -> immediate non-punishing startle/scatter animation, reset to just-before-shadow-event, deduct one click from click_budget. Also fails if click_budget exhausted before win_condition.
levels.intro_text: Something's watching the sky. Reach the sugar, but don't ignore it.

levels.title: Lesion
levels.goal_text: This hotspot is damaged. Find another that does the same thing.
levels.win_condition: fly enters sugar_radius of sugar_position (via the LIVE twin, turn_right, since sugar sits on the lesioned side), then feed hotspot is clicked while fly remains inside sugar_radius.
levels.fail_condition: click_budget exhausted before win_condition is met. Clicking dead_hotspot produces no motion/reaction (and after the 2nd such click, plays a small confused/idle animation as a nudge -- does not reveal the answer).
levels.intro_text: One of your usual hotspots isn't responding. The behavior still exists somewhere -- find where.

levels.title: Threshold
levels.goal_text: She's close. Convince yourself, then make your move.
levels.win_condition: object_track and approach_odor are each clicked at least once, in either order, followed by a wing_song click within threshold_window_ms (4000ms) of whichever of the two lands second.
levels.fail_condition: if wing_song is clicked before both object_track and approach_odor have landed, OR after threshold_window_ms has expired since the second one landed, play the half_hearted_song animation instead (this consumes a click and does not end the level -- player can retry within remaining click_budget). Level fails if click_budget exhausted before win_condition is met.
levels.intro_text: One glance isn't enough to convince a fly. Build the case, then make your move.

notes.weak_spot_type: Levels of type 'weak_spot' are not hand-authored here -- they are generated at runtime from task_templates.json, selecting whichever template best overlaps the player's 3 weakest hotspots. See task_templates.json.
notes.hotspot_ids_are_placeholders: All hotspot ids above (walk_forward, turn_left, etc.) are descriptive placeholders pending real hs_XX ids from Sam/Shreya's neuPrint work -- find-and-replace pass needed once those are assigned.

hotspot_notebook_entries.walk_forward: Legs found their rhythm -- a steady march forward.
hotspot_notebook_entries.walk_backward: It backed up like it hit reverse. Neat trick for something with no reverse gear.
hotspot_notebook_entries.turn_left: A hard bank to the left. Whatever's over there, it wants a closer look -- or it's steering clear.
hotspot_notebook_entries.turn_right: Mirror image of the last one -- same circuit, opposite side.
hotspot_notebook_entries.freeze_stop: Everything just... stopped. Not a glitch -- a decision.
hotspot_notebook_entries.escape_takeoff: Gone. One instant it's standing there, the next it's airborne.
hotspot_notebook_entries.flight: Wings locked into a blur. This one doesn't touch down for a while.
hotspot_notebook_entries.groom_head: Front legs sweep over the head and antennae, over and over.
hotspot_notebook_entries.groom_wings_abdomen: Now it's working the wings and back half -- a full-body once-over.
hotspot_notebook_entries.feed: Proboscis out, reaching for something sweet.
hotspot_notebook_entries.object_track: Its whole body swiveled to keep something in sight. Something moved -- and it noticed.
hotspot_notebook_entries.approach_odor: Nose to the wind (or whatever a fly uses instead), moving toward a smell.
hotspot_notebook_entries.avoid_odor: Same wind, opposite reaction -- it wants nothing to do with this one.
hotspot_notebook_entries.wing_song: One wing pops out and starts to vibrate. This is a fly with something to say.
hotspot_notebook_entries.halt_bitter: Proboscis retracts, fast. Wrong choice -- and it knows it immediately.
hotspot_notebook_entries.half_hearted_song: The wing twitches, half-commits, and folds back in. Not enough conviction yet.
